clauses.text:
I hereby establish the follow-
ing Order for the Canal Zone.
SEC. I. Any person who shall without lawful authority take
or remove the packing or waste from out of any journal box or
boxes of any locomotive engine, tender, coach, caboose or truck,
used or operated on any railroad, shall be guilty of a misde-
mneanor, and upon conviction shall be sentenced to pay a fine
not exceeding One Hundred Dollars, or imprisonment in jail not
exceeding thirty days, or both fine and imprisonment, in the dis-
cretion of the court.

clauses.label: SEC. 2.

source.page_or_item: ProQuest Congressional Replica of Original, file PT1-1911-EO-1412.pdf (1 pages)

clauses.text:
SEC. 2. This order shall take effect sixty days from and after
this date.
WM H TAFT
THlE WHITE HOL~E,
Septenher z.,i, 1911.
[No. 1412.]
